title: Mixed-Use Special Districts — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Mixed-use districts permit new residential and nonresidential uses, including commercial, community facility, and light industrial, as of right in the same area. Pairing residence and manufacturing districts lets cities keep jobs near homes without heavy-industry conflicts. This overview edition presents Mixed-Use Special Districts as a core zoning concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Separate incompatible uses while allowing compatible mixes
Keep rules predictable and legible for applicants
mechanisms: Set bulk controls for FAR, height, and setbacks

real_examples.fact: New York's Special Mixed Use District pairs manufacturing and residence districts under tailored rules.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
